executive_summary: The Planning Board Special Meeting on July 23, 2026, primarily focused on the approval of supplemental capital project appropriation requests for the Yearwood Center renovations. The board discussed the need for additional funding due to the discovery of asbestos and the necessity to vacate the building, which disrupted community services. The meeting also addressed the closeout of various capital projects to reallocate unused ARP funds to the Yearwood Center project. The board approved the funding reallocation and the closeout of several projects to support the renovations.

key_topics.summary: The board confirmed a quorum and approved the minutes from the previous meeting without amendments.

The board discussed the need for additional funds for the Yearwood Center renovations due to asbestos issues and the need to vacate the building. The funding sources include ARP funds, disaster recovery proceeds, and private contributions.
The board reviewed and approved the closeout of several capital projects, reallocating unused ARP funds to the Yearwood Center project.
